requirements.title: What this needs, and what Levelrail adds
requirements.elevatedWarning: This template asks for elevated access to the host. Levelrail never grants it automatically.
requirements.acknowledge: I understand and accept the elevated access listed above

finding.privileged: Runs in privileged mode, which gives the container near-root access to the host
finding.docker_socket: Mounts the Docker socket, which is equivalent to root on the host
finding.host_network: Uses host networking and bypasses the app network and ingress
finding.host_namespace: Shares a host process, IPC or user namespace
finding.devices: Passes host devices into the container
finding.host_mount: Mounts a directory from the host
finding.unpinned_image: Image is not pinned to a version tag, so a redeploy can pull different code
finding.published_ports: Publishes ports directly on the host
finding.required_secrets: You must provide one or more secrets before it can deploy
finding.generated_secrets: Passwords and keys are generated at deploy time
finding.no_healthcheck: No health check, so a deploy is judged by the process starting
finding.unparsed: The Compose body could not be analyzed, review it before deploying

protection.https_ingress: Automatic HTTPS and an ingress shield in front of every domain
protection.secret_masking: Secrets are generated, stored encrypted and masked in logs and the UI
protection.volume_backups: Named volumes can be backed up and restored
protection.health_gated_deploy: Deploys are gated on the health check before traffic switches
protection.rollback: One-step rollback to the previous revision
protection.exposure_report: Exposure report shows what is reachable from outside
protection.firewall: Host firewall rules managed for published ports
